message.content:
It depends on what you’re looking for:

| Context | Top scorer |
|---------|------------|
| **All‑time Lakers franchise record** | LeBron James (2,673 points in 2019–2023) |
| **Current season (2025‑26)** | LeBron James (averaging ~28 pts/game) – he’s still the leading scorer on the roster, with Anthony Davis close behind. |

If you meant a different metric (e.g., most points in a single game, or the highest scorer in the most recent season), let me know and I can dig into that!
